_note: akr-baidu-1/2 are hotel and generator photos; akr-page-2 is a generic night runway shot of a twin-aisle jet — Akure takes no widebodies and its runway is unlit.

akr-page-1.webp.zh: 阿库雷机场的航站楼：米黄色墙面配蓝色屋檐，入口上方是弧形雨棚，路缘刷着蓝白相间的标线。
akr-page-1.webp.en: Akure Airport's terminal — cream walls under a blue roof, curved canopies over the entrances and a blue-and-white kerb line.

akr-page-3.webp.zh: Overland Airways 的 ATR 72 涡桨客机停在阿库雷机场的机坪上（注册号 5N-BPE）。
akr-page-3.webp.en: An Overland Airways ATR 72 (registration 5N-BPE) parked on Akure's apron.

akr-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 旅客们走在航站楼前的道路上，米色墙面配着蓝色屋檐，墙边还装着一口卫星天线。
akr-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Passengers walk along the road in front of the cream terminal, past a wall-mounted satellite dish and a blue roof edge.

akr-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 灰蒙蒙的天色下，写着「阿库雷机场」的门楼立在入口，几个人在路边等候。
akr-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Under a hazy grey sky, the entrance gate carrying the words 'Welcome to Akure Airport' stands over the road.

akr-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 旅客们穿过机坪，走向一架写着奥弗兰德货运的涡桨飞机，后方停着一架白色喷气货机。
akr-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Passengers cross the apron towards an Overland Cargo turboprop, with a white freighter marked Allied Air parked behind.

akr-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 到达厅入口上方搭着蓝色半透明雨棚，门边贴着防疫提示海报，旅客正往里走。
akr-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A translucent blue canopy shelters the arrival entrance, where a pandemic health poster is fixed beside the door.

akr-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 机场入口前的广场上，绿篱围着指路牌，车辆停在路边，远处是塔台和航站楼。
akr-chatgpt-05.webp.en: At the forecourt a hedge surrounds the direction sign, cars wait along the kerb and the tower stands beyond.

akr-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 机坪上停着一架白蓝涂装的支线客机，机旁有地勤和一辆白色小巴，四周十分空旷。
akr-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A white and blue regional jet rests on the apron with ground staff and a service van alongside under a cloudy sky.

akr-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 航拍视角下，一条跑道笔直穿过深绿色的林地与灌木，两端各有一片空地。
akr-chatgpt-07.webp.en: From above, a single runway cuts straight through dark green scrub and woodland, with clearings at either end.
